import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pos {
        int x, y;
        Pos() {}
        Pos(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int DIRS = 4;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static int N, T;
    static char[][] A = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] B = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(vis[i], false);
        }
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        vis[sx][sy] = true;
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new Pos(sx, sy));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < DIRS; ++i) {
                int nx = cur.x + dx[i], ny = cur.y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && !vis[nx][ny] && Character.isDigit(A[nx][ny])) {
                    vis[nx][ny] = true;
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[cur.x][cur.y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Pos(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[72][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] ok = new boolean[12][12][12][12];

    static int[][] cap = new int[290][290];
    static int[] par = new int[290];
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[290];

    static boolean bfsDinic() {
        Arrays.fill(visited, false);
        Arrays.fill(par, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        visited[0] = true;
        q.offer(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (u == 2 * N * N + 1) return true;
            for (int v = 0; v <= 2 * N * N + 1; ++v) {
                if (cap[u][v] > 0 && !visited[v]) {
                    visited[v] = true;
                    par[v] = u;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void process() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            A[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            B[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        sx = sc.nextInt();
        sy = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(sx, sy);
        for (int t = 0; t < 72; ++t) {
            for (int px = 0; px < 12; ++px) {
                for (int py = 0; py < 12; ++py) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < 12; ++x) {
                        Arrays.fill(dp[t][px][py][x], false);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(A[i][j])) {
                    dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {
            for (int px = 0; px < N; ++px) {
                for (int py = 0; py < N; ++py) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                            if (!dp[t][px][py][x][y]) continue;
                            if (dist[x][y] <= t) continue;
                            for (int d = 0; d < DIRS; ++d) {
                                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && Character.isDigit(A[nx][ny]) && dist[nx][ny] >= t + 1) {
                                    dp[t + 1][px][py][nx][ny] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int px = 0; px < 12; ++px) {
            for (int py = 0; py < 12; ++py) {
                for (int x = 0; x < 12; ++x) {
                    Arrays.fill(ok[px][py][x], false);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int px = 0; px < N; ++px) {
                for (int py = 0; py < N; ++py) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                            if (dp[t][px][py][x][y]) {
                                ok[px][py][x][y] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 290; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(A[i][j])) {
                    cap[0][i * N + j + 1] = A[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(B[i][j])) {
                    cap[N * N + i * N + j + 1][2 * N * N + 1] = B[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (!Character.isDigit(A[i][j])) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < N; ++l) {
                        if (!Character.isDigit(A[k][l])) continue;
                        if (!ok[i][j][k][l]) continue;
                        cap[i * N + j + 1][N * N + k * N + l + 1] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        while (bfsDinic()) {
            int f = INF;
            for (int u = 2 * N * N + 1; u != 0; u = par[u]) {
                f = Math.min(f, cap[par[u]][u]);
            }
            for (int u = 2 * N * N + 1; u != 0; u = par[u]) {
                cap[par[u]][u] -= f;
                cap[u][par[u]] += f;
            }
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * N * N + 1; ++i) {
            total += cap[i][0];
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        process();
    }
}
